name: hasMobileIncidentEscalationCapability
definition: True when the vendor's own escalation configuration shows at least one escalation group that pages its members by a mobile method (SMS, phone, voice or push), not email alone.
population: the escalation groups the connected managed-detection tenant lists
evidenceRequiredForTrue: At least one escalation group whose delivery methods include a mobile method (proof even on a partial read), or a complete read of at least one group none of which has one (False). No group, an error or refused answer, or a partial read with no mobile method is not measured.
